einzeiler: Two Australian women charm London high society before a massive investment fraud unfolds.
kurzfassung: Two Australian women arrived in 1990s London and quickly became prominent figures in British high society through their wealth and vibrant personalities. One of them began offering an exclusive investment opportunity that successfully attracted substantial funds from wealthy businessmen and elites. Eventually, a local detective pursued the duo, leading to a decades-later confession about the massive deception.
stichpunkte: Two Australian women arrived in 1990s London and integrated into high society.
The pair became known for their wealth, striking red hair, and flamboyant lifestyles.
One of the women promoted an exclusive investment scheme that promised massive financial returns.
Wealthy businessmen and members of the equestrian elite invested heavily in the opportunity.
The duo even secured a meeting with Queen Elizabeth.
A small town detective eventually investigated the pair and vowed to stop them.
Decades later, one of the individuals involved opened up about the massive deception.

clips.hook: Australian women take 1990s London by storm
clips.text: Two Australian women moved to London during the 1990s and immediately gained popularity among British high society while standing out with their distinct red hair and wealth.

beschreibung:
Two Aussie lesbian lovers touch down in 1990s London and become the toast of British high society. They charm rich businessmen, England's horse-loving elite, and even Queen Elizabeth herself. But the glamorous duo are concealing a dark past and dastardly intentions—and when a small-town detective vows to bring them down, he finds they are exceedingly hard to catch.
Hosted by award-winning journalist Becky Milligan. Royal Swindle is a Blanchard House production for USG Audio, in partnership with Exactly Right Media.
Premieres Thursday, July 23rd. Follow Royal Swindle wherever you get your podcasts—and see rare photos from the story at @exactlyright on Instagram.
